reason: Alert 1 (java/xss): alert-TP — resolved sink value is param, which reaches the HTML response via encodeForHTML. The data flows from getParameterNames to param, then to doSomething, and finally to new String(input) which is passed to encodeForHTML. Although encodeForHTML is applied, the user input (param) is still the value being encoded and output to the HTML response, making it vulnerable to XSS if not properly sanitized elsewhere. Case TP: at least one alert-TP.
